reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was "Every batch lab-tested" with the QR code, which is a nice touch, but there is no NSF or USP seal and no reviews, and I already have a magnesium I trust in my pill organizer. I am not swapping a known brand for an unknown one at $1 a day.
objection: New brand, zero reviews, no NSF or USP seal. A QR code to the brand's own chosen lab is not the same as third-party certification, and I already have a magnesium that works for me.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification mark on the box, plus a few hundred verified reviews or a lower trial price for a smaller box.
